name: feature.media.nodes
description: Media-library feature node pack — the ADR 0352 P4 weighted image selection over ctx.features.media (facet=full weight, tag=half, 5-level fallback, `needsAsset` when nothing matches), so a campaign/content workflow can pick on-brand library imagery. role:action (recorded ⇒ replay reads the recorded selection). The createAssetFromServeUrl write stays covered by its consumer pack (feature.campaign-channels.nodes render-concepts).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Media: Select Assets
nodes.description: Deterministic weighted selection over the org's image library via ctx.features.media.select (ADR 0352 P4). Inputs: { orgId, product?, industry?, useCase?, personaIds?, collectionId?, limit? }. Output: { assets, fallbackLevel, needsAsset? }.
